server.session_tenancy.no_principal: session RPCs require an authenticated principal
server.session_tenancy.readonly_write: role %q may list and load its own sessions but cannot save or delete them
server.session_tenancy.admin_access: admin access to the shared session namespace
server.session_tenancy.unavailable: per-principal session storage is not configured on this server; only an admin can use saved sessions here
server.session_tenancy.open_failed: could not open the principal's session store
server.session_tenancy.rebind_denied: this channel identity is bound to another principal; only an admin can move it
server.provider_endpoint.key_refused: provider_config key %q is not accepted by this server (accepted: client_id, client_key, realm, agent_id, base_url)
server.provider_endpoint.segment_invalid: provider_config %s must be a single path segment of letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore
server.provider_endpoint.base_url_provid: provider_config base_url only applies to provider OLLAMA, not %q
server.provider_endpoint.invalid: provider_config base_url must be an http or https URL without credentials, query or fragment
server.provider_endpoint.not_allowlisted: this server does not accept the client-chosen endpoint %s. Configure the endpoint on the server itself (OLLAMA_BASE_URL), or have the server operator add this origin to %s
server.provider_endpoint.allowlist_entry: ignoring an invalid entry in the provider endpoint allowlist
server.provider_endpoint.dial_blocked: refusing to connect to %s: loopback, private, link-local, multicast and metadata addresses cannot be reached through a client-chosen endpoint
